# useStream

发起流式请求，把收到的片段累积成一个值，如 AI 回复的文字。可以停止、重新开始；停止、重新开始、组件卸载时都会中止请求。片段到达很密集时（每秒数百个），值每个动画帧最多更新一次。片段用 `readSSE` 或 `readTextStream` 读取，也可以返回任意异步可迭代对象。

**分类**：AI 与流式　**常见用途**：流式的 AI 回复、可以停止的长时间生成、任何 `text/event-stream` 接口

## 引入

```ts
import { useStream } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## 签名

```ts
useStream<T, V, A extends readonly unknown[] = []>(options: UseStreamOptions<T, V, A>): StreamState<V, A>
```

## 基本用法

`request` 返回响应中的事件（这里是模拟的接口；实际页面中用 `fetch`，并传同一个 `signal`）。文字随事件到达而增长；
"Stop" 中止请求，保留已经收到的部分。

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Inline,
  Pill,
  type PillTone,
  readSSE,
  type ServerSentEvent,
  Stack,
  type StreamStatus,
  Text,
  useStream,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface FakeStreamOptions {
  /** Aborts the stream, like the `signal` of `fetch`. */
  readonly signal?: AbortSignal
  /** Characters per event. */
  readonly chunk?: number
  /** Milliseconds between events. */
  readonly interval?: number
  /** Fails with this error after this many characters. */
  readonly failAfter?: number
}

function fakeSSE(text: string, options: FakeStreamOptions = {}): Response {
  const { chunk = 3, interval = 30, signal, failAfter } = options
  if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  let sent = 0
  const body = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    start(controller) {
      const next = () => {
        if (failAfter !== undefined && sent >= failAfter) {
          controller.error(new Error('The connection was reset'))
          return
        }
        if (sent >= text.length) {
          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode('data: [DONE]\n\n'))
          controller.close()
          return
        }
        const delta = text.slice(sent, sent + chunk)
        sent += delta.length
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ delta })}\n\n`))
        timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
      }
      timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
    },
    cancel() {
      clearTimeout(timer)
    },
  })
  return new Response(body, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/event-stream' } })
}

const ANSWER =
  'Streaming shows the reply while it is being written, so people can start reading at once and stop it when it goes off track.'

const appendDelta = (text: string, e: ServerSentEvent) =>
  e.data === '[DONE]' ? text : text + (JSON.parse(e.data) as { delta: string }).delta

const TONES: Record<StreamStatus, PillTone> = {
  idle: 'neutral',
  streaming: 'accent',
  done: 'success',
  error: 'danger',
  stopped: 'warning',
}

export function Basic() {
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal) => readSSE(fakeSSE(ANSWER, { signal }), { signal }),
    initial: '',
    reduce: appendDelta,
  })
  const streaming = reply.status === 'streaming'
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Inline gap={2} align="center">
        {streaming ? (
          <Button onClick={reply.stop}>Stop</Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => reply.start()}>
            Generate
          </Button>
        )}
        <Pill tone={TONES[reply.status]}>{reply.status}</Pill>
      </Inline>
      <Text as="p">{reply.value || '—'}</Text>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## 状态

### 失败与重试

连接中断时 `status` 变为 `error`，`error` 是原因，已经收到的文字保留。`start` 的参数会传给 `request`。

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  ErrorState,
  Inline,
  readSSE,
  type ServerSentEvent,
  Stack,
  Text,
  useStream,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface FakeStreamOptions {
  /** Aborts the stream, like the `signal` of `fetch`. */
  readonly signal?: AbortSignal
  /** Characters per event. */
  readonly chunk?: number
  /** Milliseconds between events. */
  readonly interval?: number
  /** Fails with this error after this many characters. */
  readonly failAfter?: number
}

function fakeSSE(text: string, options: FakeStreamOptions = {}): Response {
  const { chunk = 3, interval = 30, signal, failAfter } = options
  if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  let sent = 0
  const body = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    start(controller) {
      const next = () => {
        if (failAfter !== undefined && sent >= failAfter) {
          controller.error(new Error('The connection was reset'))
          return
        }
        if (sent >= text.length) {
          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode('data: [DONE]\n\n'))
          controller.close()
          return
        }
        const delta = text.slice(sent, sent + chunk)
        sent += delta.length
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ delta })}\n\n`))
        timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
      }
      timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
    },
    cancel() {
      clearTimeout(timer)
    },
  })
  return new Response(body, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/event-stream' } })
}

const ANSWER =
  'Streaming shows the reply while it is being written, so people can start reading at once and stop it when it goes off track.'

const appendDelta = (text: string, e: ServerSentEvent) =>
  e.data === '[DONE]' ? text : text + (JSON.parse(e.data) as { delta: string }).delta

export function Failure() {
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal, failAfter?: number) =>
      readSSE(fakeSSE(ANSWER, { signal, failAfter }), { signal }),
    initial: '',
    reduce: appendDelta,
  })
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Inline gap={2}>
        <Button onClick={() => reply.start(40)} disabled={reply.status === 'streaming'}>
          Generate (fails halfway)
        </Button>
      </Inline>
      <Text as="p">{reply.value || '—'}</Text>
      {reply.status === 'error' && (
        <ErrorState
          size="sm"
          message={reply.error instanceof Error ? reply.error.message : undefined}
          onRetry={() => reply.start()}
        />
      )}
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## 选项

| 选项 | 类型 | 说明 | 默认值 | 必填 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | `( signal: AbortSignal, ...args: A ) => AsyncIterable<T> \| Promise<AsyncIterable<T>>` | 发起请求并返回片段，如 `readSSE(await fetch(url, { signal }), { signal })`。要把 `signal` 传给 `fetch` 与读取函数：停止、重新开始或组件卸载时它会被中止。`signal` 之后的参数就是 `start` 的参数。 | — | 是 |
| `initial` | `V` | 收到第一个片段之前的值；`start` 与 `reset` 都回到这个值。 | — | 是 |
| `reduce` | `(value: V, chunk: T) => V` | 把一个片段并入当前值，如 `(text, e) => text + JSON.parse(e.data).delta`。返回新值，不要修改旧值。抛出异常时流失败。 | — | 是 |
| `onDone` | `(value: V) => void` | 流正常结束时以最终的值调用（被停止时不调用）。 | — | 否 |
| `onError` | `(error: unknown, value: V) => void` | 请求或 `reduce` 失败时调用，参数是错误与已经收到的部分。 | — | 否 |

## 类型

上文用到的本库类型，用 `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'` 引入。

### StreamState<V, A>

useStream 的返回值。

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 | 默认值 | 必填 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `V` | 到目前为止累积的值。停止或失败后保留。 | — | 是 |
| `status` | `'idle' \| 'streaming' \| 'done' \| 'error' \| 'stopped'` | 流的状态。 | — | 是 |
| `error` | `unknown` | `status` 为 `error` 时的错误，其他时候为 `undefined`。 | — | 是 |
| `start` | `(...args: A) => void` | 用这些参数开始一个流；仍在进行的流先被中止。值从 `initial` 重新开始。 | — | 是 |
| `stop` | `() => void` | 停止进行中的流：中止请求，状态立即变为 `stopped`，保留已经收到的部分。没有进行中的流时什么也不做。 | — | 是 |
| `reset` | `() => void` | 中止进行中的流，回到 `idle` 与 `initial` 值。 | — | 是 |
